name: Bharat Bijlee Ltd
about: Established in 1946, Bharat Bijlee is a leading electrical engineering company in India engaged in manufacturing of transformers, electric motors, elevator systems, drives and automation. It also provides turnkey solutions for EHV switchyards, HV and MV substations, Electrical Balance of Plant, etc. [1]

pros: Company has delivered good profit growth of 24.5% CAGR over last 5 years
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 29.0%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 55.3 days to 36.3 days
cons: Company has a low return on equity of 7.25% over last 3 years.
